{{Top|leg}}
'''Home of Wisdom''' was the [[Tarasin]] name used to indicate a sacred area within the territory of the [[Hiironi irstat]]. Created by weaving the branches of the overhanging trees together, the House was nothing more than a dry area beneath the branches where the [[Gender/Legends|females]] could gather to discuss philosophy. Within the House, the Tarasin first met with [[Reidi Artom]].<ref name="Wisdom">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040325wisdom|text=Home of Wisdom}}</ref>
